text:
maya-partnerships: Kicking off a compact pilot playbook to get Redwood Inference listed across AWS/GCP/Azure. Goal: validate private offer flow, public SKU packaging, and legal copy for EU data residency. Short checklist and owners below.

chris-cloud: I'll handle publisher account IDs + IAM least-privilege roles. Quick note: GCP requires publisher service account + roles/cloudbilling.user; AWS needs aws-marketplace-manager role.

olivia-legal: I'll draft minimal marketplace legal (EULA + residency opt-out + telemetry clause). Also need to know if logs ever contain customer prompts (PII risk).

sam-product: SKU proposal: dev (metered), business (token-based), enterprise (reserved + SI-managed). Add an "integration" SKU for SI/hardware partners. Trial: 7-day for dev, 14-day for business.

devon-ops: Private offers: require customer KMS key ARN, and for Azure a subscription-level consent. We'll prepare example cross-account KMS IAM policy and a Terraform snippet for onboarding.

marketplace-bot: Reminder: manifest validator will fail if support contact is missing or logo assets <1024px. Please preflight assets.

maya-partnerships: Pilot tasks (owners):
- Publisher IDs & IAM doc: chris-cloud
- Marketplace manifest + example pricing.json: sam-product + chris-cloud
- Legal copy + residency clause: olivia-legal
- KMS + network playbook + terraform snippet: devon-ops
- Pilot customer coordination + test accounts: maya-partnerships

chris-cloud: Draft IAM snippet (placeholder) below for review:

```
# AWS example: cross-account KMS key policy (snippet)
{
  "Version": "2012-10-17",
  "Statement": [
    {
      "Sid": "AllowMarketplacePublish",
      "Effect": "Allow",
      "Principal": {"AWS": "arn:aws:iam::111122223333:role/aws-marketplace-manager"},
      "Action": ["kms:Encrypt","kms:Decrypt","kms:GenerateDataKey*"],
      "Resource": "*"
    }
  ]
}
```

olivia-legal: Telemetry note: usage is aggregated; we don't log full prompts unless a customer opts into support-debug mode. I'll add the opt-in language.

sam-product: Pricing units: propose "token-unit" for business, "inference-hour" for enterprise reserved. SI add-on as a per-seat monthly SKU. Thoughts?

devon-ops: Works. For the pilot we should publish in these regions: us-west-2, us-east-1, europe-west1. Keep a private-offer flag per SKU.

maya-partnerships: Timeline: gather drafts by Tue EOD, run manifest validation Wed, upload to sandbox Thu, and demo pilot to partners next Mon. Sync scheduled Tue 11am PT to review artifacts. I'll drop calendar invite.

marketplace-bot: After sandbox upload, run will post validation results here. Use tag #manifest-failures for any rejections.

chris-cloud: I'll upload publisher IDs and initial terraform snippets to the shared drive today.

olivia-legal: Draft will be in drive by Tue morning for quick review.

sam-product: I'll produce pricing.json + support contact details by Monday.

devon-ops: I'll prepare the KMS cross-account example and a basic VPC diagram for private-offer flow.

maya-partnerships: Thanks all. If any hardware partner leads want to be part of the pilot (for appliance listing or co-branded offers), reply here and I'll loop them in.
